newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan police arrest Bhutto's party leaders.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan police arrest Bhutto's party leaders.

text.p: Pakistani police said on Monday they had arrested two leaders of former prime minister Benazir Bhutto's Pakistan People's Party (PPP) on charges of corruption.
Munawwar Talpur, a member of Sindh province assembly, was arrested from his home in Karachi, and Zafar Leghari from his farms in Dadu in Sindh province overnight, the police said.

Talpur, brother-in-law of Bhutto's jailed husband, Asif Ali Zardari, was the excise and taxation minister and Leghari was irrigation minister in the Sindh provincial cabinet of former chief minister Syed Abdullah Shah.
One police official said the two men had been arrested on charges of corruption.
Bhutto was sacked by President Farooq Leghari last November on the disputed charges of misrule and corruption, and the PPP later suffered a crushing defeat in general elections on February 3.
Zafar Leghari is not related to President Leghari.
